scientific_scope: Native coordinate registration/correspondence; no image-vector retrieval substitution. Affine DINO appearance matching is an experimental method, not a claim of reproducing an official nonrigid baseline.
layer_definition: Reuse dinov3.eval.bio_segmentation.scripts.run_linear_probe_pipeline._even4_layers(actual_backbone_depth); concatenate normalized spatial patch descriptors, never CLS vectors.

preprocessing.2d: Full RGB field of view, bilinear resize maximum side 512, dimensions rounded to patch size, no center crop or padding. ImageNet normalization and existing segmentation spatial forward; map patch centers back to native XY pixels.
preprocessing.3d: Physical XYZ micrometers, explicit FM channel, sampled 3D appearance descriptors, no z projection; one FM-to-EM affine per whole volume.

search.similarity: exact Euclidean nearest neighbor on normalized descriptors

failure_rule: Fit failure uses identity and scores every public correspondence; never drop failed pairs or missing prediction landmarks.

datasets.official_split: Official medium CSV: 481 directed pairs, 230 training with public targets, 251 evaluation with private targets. Official pairs share images and are NOT specimen disjoint.
datasets.local_split: Public 230 training pairs only, 49 tissue groups. SHA256(seed:group)-ranked development groups (25%), remainder evaluation. CIMA lung/mammary groups are ineligible for ANHIR development. Preserve official pair direction and native image scale.
datasets.grouping_unit: Tissue/specimen, all stains and resolutions; adjacent sections and pair components stay together.
datasets.primary_metric: Group-macro mean of per-group mean pair median rTRE; pair-micro mean is secondary. Neither is official mean rank across methods.
datasets.normalization: Use official cover Image diagonal [pixels] exactly: BIRL get_image_diagonal gives cover values precedence. Use measured target diagonal only when no official value exists.
datasets.annotation_handling: Eight public pairs have unequal source/target counts. Match shared explicit CSV IDs, record unmatched IDs/counts, score all shared predictions. BIRL filter_paired_landmarks explicitly uses common source/target annotations rather than treating extra annotations as corruption.
datasets.aggregation: Group-macro mean including failed pairs; group-bootstrap uncertainty reported separately. Official mean rank requires multiple methods on the same complete pair cover and is not interchangeable with mean median rTRE.
datasets.license: CC-BY-NC-SA 2.0. Official Data Usage Agreement links https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/2.0/ and permits research with data-source acknowledgment and appropriate citations. Noncommercial restriction and sharealike apply; code licenses do not license data.
datasets.challenge_server: 251 evaluation targets remain private. Source-warp CSV submission can be prepared, but hidden accuracy cannot be computed locally.

datasets.local_split: Exactly 108 unordered pairs across nine tissues at scale 25%, lexicographically earlier filename source, later filename target. Deterministic group development/evaluation holdout is PROPOSED_BY_US; do not pool scales as independent examples.
datasets.grouping_unit: Tissue/specimen, including all stains, resolutions and pairs.
datasets.primary_metric: Group-macro mean of per-group mean pair median rTRE, normalized by native target image diagonal.
datasets.aggregation: Group-macro mean including failed pairs; pair-micro mean and group-level uncertainty reported separately.
datasets.known_limitations: CIMA images also occur in ANHIR; no independent cross-dataset aggregate claim. Fixed 25% scale is declared rather than treating each scale as independent.
datasets.license: Local original-author Kaggle release CC-BY-SA 4.0; dataset-histology-landmarks BSD code license has different scope. ANHIR copies are under ANHIR CC-BY-NC-SA 2.0 terms.

datasets.official_split: 2022: 750 training cases, 100 validation, 303 released test cases. Locally available validation: 100 pairs, 200 WSIs. Training has no landmarks; validation/test target landmarks are secret.
datasets.grouping_unit: Patient/tumor-block case; all stains and tiles stay together.
datasets.primary_metric: ACROBAT 2022 median across cases of 90th-percentile TRE in micrometers. Per-landmark average distance across at least two target annotators BEFORE pair percentile. Do not use 2023 mean-p90 aggregation.
datasets.coordinate_handling: Public CSV ihc_x/y native 10X pixels convert with mpp_ihc_10X. Docker input/output world coordinates are micrometers; convert prediction once. Read pyramid overviews while retaining level-0 XY scale.
datasets.annotation_repair: Downloaded official validation public source CSV: 5020 landmarks, 100 cases. Every he_x/he_y blank as intended by the official hidden-target protocol.
datasets.license: SND CC-BY 4.0 data release; challenge participation terms are separate.

datasets.official_protocol: Paper's three-volume experiments score organelle overlap, centroid distance and manual alignment. Descriptor-affine landmark TRE is a separate experimental native method, not full paper mask-score reproduction.
datasets.local_split: Whole-volume leave-one-volume-out selection; only three independent cell-volume units. No independence claim for slices.
datasets.coordinates: Physical XYZ micrometers, ImageJ TIFF and CZI XML anisotropic calibration. BigWarp CSV exports world XYZ, not voxels; never scale landmarks twice.
datasets.primary_metric: Mean across whole volumes of median landmark TRE in micrometers; secondary rTRE by native EM physical diagonal.

search.coordinate_scope: 3D calibrated appearance correspondences, NOT a 2D proxy

datasets.license: EMPIAR/BioStudies entry-specific terms apply; MIT napari-clemreg licenses code only. BioStudies S-BSST1175 (EMPIAR-11666 FM) metadata explicitly declares CC0.
datasets.known_limitations: DINO FM-channel/EM-volume appearance extraction and genuine 3D affine matching implemented; actual 1TB sweeps and official mask/reference reproduction remain pending. EMPIAR-11666 source BigWarp Y coordinates exceed CZI physical-Y bounds, requiring authoritative orientation/calibration resolution before scoring that volume.
